_comment: D335 (BACKLOG 44): attribute points the hero gets on each level-up and what one point gives. Stats: attack (Phys. Atk.), max_health, crit_chance / dodge_chance / attack_speed (fractions, 0.004 = 0.4 %), max_sp, skill_power (skill damage and heals x(1 + v)), sp_per_hit (extra SP per landed hit and parry, D504). caps = the same ceilings StatCalculator puts on the base values. diminishing (D642): every step points give factor times less than the step before (AttributeManager.effective_points). D841: a level gives no stats by itself, so Strength (1 -> 2 Phys. Atk.) and Vitality (4 -> 9 Max HP) per point took over D642's automatic +2 Phys. Atk. / +10 Max HP: a level spent 2 Strength / 2 Vitality / 1 Wisdom gives what it gave before. Read by AttributeManager.bonus(stat). Plan: design/skill_screen_rework_plan.md
